blanks.sentence: One speaker thinks being a musician could be _____ if a person became very successful.
The programme hears from people in the UK who want to become _____.
Bailey grew up in a _____ in St Ives.
After school on Fridays, she went to _____.
Music from the 1970s had a strong _____ on Bailey.
Older musicians gave Bailey protection and _____.
Josh learned his first proper guitar song when he was _____.
A busker performs in public places to _____.
Busking helped Josh get opportunities, including all his _____ and connections.

multipleChoice.question: Why does Pippa hesitate about becoming a musician?
options: She dislikes listening to music
She thinks musicians rarely have fans
She believes success could bring stress
She has never met a musician

multipleChoice.question: What question is the programme trying to explore?
options: What life is like for people trying to become musicians
Which instrument is easiest for beginners
Why UK charts are no longer important
How to record music in a studio

multipleChoice.question: What early musical experience did Bailey have?
options: She studied only classical music at school
She avoided performing until adulthood
She grew up without local music events
She attended open mic events from about age eleven

multipleChoice.question: What do the older musicians and 1970s songs help explain about Bailey?
options: Why she stopped writing music
How her musical taste and development were shaped
Why she moved away from St Ives
How she became the oldest person in the group

multipleChoice.question: What are songwriters’ circles?
options: Meetings for people interested in writing music
Paid concerts for famous artists only
Competitions for chart positions
Lessons about music marketing

multipleChoice.question: What does “took me under their wing” imply in Bailey’s case?
options: They ignored her because she was young
They forced her to copy their songs
They prevented her from performing publicly
They offered her support and guidance

multipleChoice.question: What did Josh do soon after learning his first proper guitar song?
options: He joined a famous band
He started busking
He stopped playing guitar
He moved out of London

multipleChoice.question: What is a busker?
options: A person who writes music reviews
A musician who performs only online
Someone who performs in public places for money
A manager who organises concerts

multipleChoice.question: How has busking helped Josh?
options: It has provided income, gigs and connections
It has stopped him from performing to people
It has replaced all his interest in music
It has made him avoid new opportunities

multipleChoice.question: What broader point does Josh’s story suggest?
options: Street performance has no value for musicians
Musicians succeed only through formal training
Public performance prevents networking
Informal performance can become a serious career pathway
